synopsis: Ako Kobayashi is a high school girl eagerly awaiting her prince charming to sweep her off her feet, but she has to overcome one small problem: she is so afraid of guys that she breaks out in hives whenever she comes near one. However, after Kei learns of Ako's condition, he comes to school the next day dressed as a girl and asks her out again

synonyms: Two Girls in Love with High Grade Model Kits
Two People in Love with HG
synopsis: When she was 14, Sayaka Kanzaki had her first encounter with Gundam, and her fascination for MS was awakened as if by fate. But her family and friends did not understand the hobby, so she had to hide her interest from the world. Until one day, when she met a high school girl, Sora Takamiya, who loved Gundam models, too...! When two people who love Gundam meet, it's the beginning of something new–––. A story about how it feels “to like” something; a “Gunpla” slice-of-life comedy featuring an almost-thirty OL and a JK!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category. - Includes 15 extra chapters.

synopsis: Tamer. This fantasy profession cultivates relationships with almighty monsters, boasting abilities to make even the greatest hero weep in wonder. One such tamer, famed for the power of his companion beasts, gets caught up in an incident involving storage magic and is reborn into a totally different world as a youth named Varius. Here, he's faced with a terrible change to the status quo: tamers are seen as nothing but the lowest of the low. "I'll never let you insult tamers again!" Varius sets out to prove that the tamer really is the ultimate profession. Thus begins the story of the overpowered tamer who seeks to overturn the very foundations of his world! (Source: One Peace Books)
